importantDates.detail: The portal opens at 12:00 noon on 9th October 2026 and closes at 5:00 PM on 15th October 2026, by server time. Service Proforma and supporting certificates must be uploaded by the closing time.

importantDates.label: DNB/Post-MBBS Diploma: DNB service-candidate minimum continuous-service measurement date
importantDates.detail: Qualifying TNPSC/MRB and Local Body Medical Officers must have completed at least two years of continuous service as at 31st March 2026.

importantDates.label: DNB/Post-MBBS Diploma: DNB MBBS / internship completion cutoff
importantDates.detail: MBBS must be cleared and CRMI/CRRI completed or completing on or before 30th September 2026; permanent or provisional medical registration is required at counselling/admission.

importantDates.label: DNB/Post-MBBS Diploma: Current Diploma course completion cutoff for same-year DNB application
importantDates.detail: Candidates pursuing a Diploma (including AIQ) may apply in the same academic year if they complete before 30th September 2026, described as commencement of counselling. The prospectus says counselling dates will be notified later.

gaps.title: Government-quota MD/MS/Diploma: Counselling schedule and joining windows
gaps.detail: Rank publication, counselling dates, course commencement and admission closure will be notified later. Actual Round 1/2 vacating and resignation windows and later-round dates are not supplied. The application and certified service-particulars upload deadline is supplied: 15th October 2026 at 5:00 PM.

gaps.title: Government-quota MD/MS/Diploma: College, course and seat matrix
gaps.detail: The prospectus says approved 2026-2027 seats will be displayed before counselling but does not list Government Medical Colleges, Self-Financing colleges, specialties or seat counts. It also gives no prior cutoff ranks.

gaps.title: Government-quota MD/MS/Diploma: Government Quota fees in Self-Financing colleges
gaps.detail: The amount is set by the Self-Financing Professional Colleges fee-fixation committee and is not printed in this prospectus. The full tuition and special fee is due at allotment-order download.

gaps.title: Government-quota MD/MS/Diploma: Exact stipend, salary and compensation interest rate
gaps.detail: The prospectus refers to Government Orders/institution norms for stipend and salary, and to the Tamil Nadu Government housing-loan rate for compensation interest, but gives no numerical rates.

gaps.title: Government-quota MD/MS/Diploma: Rank tie-break rules
gaps.detail: The prospectus says rank is based on NEET-PG marks with eligible in-service weightage and refers to reservation/roster; it does not state a tie-break order.

gaps.title: Government-quota MD/MS/Diploma: Complete security-deposit refund eligibility
gaps.detail: The source says the deposit is refunded to eligible candidates who get no seat in any phase, but does not define all eligible cases. It names a Round 3 not-joined case in which deposit is forfeited.

gaps.title: Government-quota MD/MS/Diploma: Whether a separate Round 2 registration fee applies
gaps.detail: A ₹1,000 fee is stated for Round 1, Round 3 and the Stray Vacancy Round. The prospectus does not clearly state whether the Round 1 registration fee covers Round 2 or whether a separate Round 2 registration fee is collected.

gaps.title: Government-quota MD/MS/Diploma: PwD special-category application form
gaps.detail: Page 6 requires a filled and certified special-category form said to be provided in the prospectus. Pages 1–60 contain the disability eligibility matrix but no separately identifiable candidate application form. Confirm the form location with the Selection Committee.

gaps.title: Government-quota MD/MS/Diploma: Current hilly/remote/difficult/rural station list and weightage calculation
gaps.detail: The prospectus gives the maximum service weightage but not the current station list, a calculation method or rules for partial service years.

gaps.title: Government-quota MD/MS/Diploma: Service-bond terms for Government Quota seats in Self-Financing colleges
gaps.detail: Service candidates in these seats may refer to G.O. (Ms.) No.46 dated 7th February 2020, but that order is not reproduced in this prospectus.

gaps.title: Government-quota MD/MS/Diploma: DNB/MDS and detailed specialty coverage
gaps.detail: The cover describes MD/MS degree and Diploma counselling. This source does not provide a DNB or MDS seat list or counselling scope, although DNB appears in prior-course exclusion clauses and MDS appears on the generic Annexure III bond-form heading. Do not infer that these courses are covered.

gaps.title: Government-quota MD/MS/Diploma: NRI seat terms
gaps.detail: This Government Quota prospectus does not describe NRI seats or an NRI quota. Check the applicable current-year prospectus for any other seat type.

gaps.title: Government-quota MD/MS/Diploma: Detailed Tamil Nadu nativity test
gaps.detail: The prospectus requires a competent Tamil Nadu Revenue Department nativity certificate and refers to candidates native to Tamil Nadu/other States, but does not define the evidence or route that makes a candidate a Tamil Nadu native.

gaps.title: Government-quota MD/MS/Diploma: Tamil Nadu subcategory and roster fit
gaps.detail: The source distinguishes BC, BCM, MBC, DNC, SC, SCA and ST and gives count-dependent roster/conversion rules. The current profile category field cannot distinguish those subcategories, model the 200-point roster or calculate seat-count-dependent reservations; manual certificate and roster review is required.

gaps.title: Government-quota MD/MS/Diploma: EWS category
gaps.detail: The reservation categories and community lists in this prospectus name Open, BC, BCM, MBC/DNC, SC, SCA and ST; no EWS eligibility or EWS allotment rule is stated in this Government Quota prospectus.

gaps.title: Management/NRI MD/MS/Diploma: Counselling and admission timetable
gaps.detail: The prospectus says the expected rank-list date, tentative counselling dates, course commencement and closure of admission will be notified later. Round-specific resignation and vacating windows are also not given.

gaps.title: Management/NRI MD/MS/Diploma: College, course and seat matrix
gaps.detail: The prospectus does not provide the full college-by-course seat list or sanctioned-seat matrix; it says approved seats will be displayed before counselling.

gaps.title: Management/NRI MD/MS/Diploma: College / course tuition and special-fee amounts
gaps.detail: Exact tuition and special fees are delegated to the Fee Fixation Committee for 2026–2027 and are not stated in this prospectus.

gaps.title: Management/NRI MD/MS/Diploma: Minority seat-sharing percentages and priority
gaps.detail: Seat sharing between self-financing minority and non-minority colleges is delegated to State Policy, MCI regulations and applicable Court orders. The prospectus gives no numerical minority allocation or priority order.

gaps.title: Management/NRI MD/MS/Diploma: Management / NRI service bond
gaps.detail: This prospectus does not state a service bond for Management Quota / NRI admissions.

gaps.title: Management/NRI MD/MS/Diploma: Citizenship and non-Indian nationality interpretation
gaps.detail: Clauses 5(i) and 5(ii) conflict: one says candidates should be Indian citizens, while the next names OCI, PIO and foreign nationals as eligible subject to other rules. No resolution is given.

gaps.title: Management/NRI MD/MS/Diploma: NRI applicant and sponsor verification
gaps.detail: Candidate-origin routes, NRI sponsor status, relationship category, blood-relative degree and legal-guardian status require manual review; the profile cannot test these criteria exactly. The prospectus gives no separate parent-absence exception for legal guardians.

gaps.title: Management/NRI MD/MS/Diploma: NRI selection marks phrase
gaps.detail: The prospectus says NRI admission “may be made” on marks in the qualifying examination “as prescribed” but does not define the examination or the criteria in this passage; it separately says the state rank list is based on NEET PG marks.

gaps.title: Management/NRI MD/MS/Diploma: Whether the ₹2,00,000 deposit applies to NRI seats
gaps.detail: The security-deposit clause says “For Management Quota” while the prospectus title covers Management Quota including NRI and describes NRI as a subquota. The extraction associates it with both pending confirmation.

gaps.title: Management/NRI MD/MS/Diploma: Cross-counselling round-history eligibility
gaps.detail: Round 3 and Stray eligibility depend on prior allotment / joining / resignation and current seats in State, All India, Deemed University, DNB and Stray rounds; these facts are not in the profile.

gaps.title: Management/NRI MD/MS/Diploma: Round 3 registration fee for candidates holding an earlier joined seat
gaps.detail: The Round 3 fee clause says candidates allotted and not joined / resigned and fresh registrants pay ₹1,000, then says only candidates not allotted in Rounds 1 and 2 need not pay. It does not clearly state whether a candidate who joined and still holds an earlier seat pays.

gaps.title: DNB/Post-MBBS Diploma: DNB rank-list and counselling schedule
gaps.detail: Notification and application dates are given, but the rank-list date, counselling dates, course commencement and admission closure are all marked 'will be notified later.' Follow tnmedicalselection.net.

gaps.title: DNB/Post-MBBS Diploma: DNB hospital, specialty and seat matrix
gaps.detail: The prospectus states that 50% of recognized/permitted DNB seats are All India Quota and 50% State Quota, but it does not list accredited hospitals, specialty/course-wise seats or seat counts.

gaps.title: DNB/Post-MBBS Diploma: DNB rank tie-break and service weightage
gaps.detail: The prospectus says the State Rank List is based on NEET-PG 2026 marks and selection uses merit/reservation. It gives no tie-break procedure or separate service-duration weightage.

gaps.title: DNB/Post-MBBS Diploma: DNB qualifying score out of 800
gaps.detail: The table on merged p.98 has blank minimum-eligibility and score-out-of-800 cells. Text on merged p.99 states category percentiles but gives no corresponding marks out of 800.

gaps.title: DNB/Post-MBBS Diploma: DNB tuition, special fees and stipend amounts
gaps.detail: Tuition and other special fees are payable at admission and stipend is paid under later Government Orders and institutional norms, but this prospectus gives no rupee amounts.

gaps.title: DNB/Post-MBBS Diploma: DNB specialty names and accredited institution list
gaps.detail: The prospectus refers to Government Medical Colleges, Government Head Quarters Hospitals and Sub-District Hospitals, but does not provide a hospital list or specialty list.

gaps.title: DNB/Post-MBBS Diploma: The candidate profile cannot identify a DNB applicant
gaps.detail: The existing profile has a general clinical course type but no DNB / MD-MS / Diploma subtype. DNB-specific eligibility rules therefore remain manual checks and must not restrict every clinical candidate.

gaps.title: DNB/Post-MBBS Diploma: The candidate profile cannot represent every Tamil Nadu reservation category
gaps.detail: The source distinguishes BC, BCM, MBC, DNC, SC, SCA and ST; the existing profile only has generic UR/OBC/SC/ST/EWS values. Category eligibility and certificate checks require manual review.

gaps.title: DNB/Post-MBBS Diploma: The candidate profile cannot verify the full DNB service definition
gaps.detail: The profile does not collect TNPSC/MRB selection route, Local Body employment, appointment type, continuous service as at 31st March 2026, service remaining after the course or superannuation date. Service-candidate criteria remain a manual check.

gaps.title: DNB/Post-MBBS Diploma: The candidate profile cannot resolve the DNB Tamil Nadu nativity route
gaps.detail: The profile's domicile and MBBS-state fields do not establish Tamil Nadu nativity or dual nativity, and the prospectus does not explain how the other-state MBBS nativity route interacts with the Tamil Nadu MBBS/CRMI requirement.

gaps.title: DNB/Post-MBBS Diploma: The candidate profile cannot evaluate DNB medical disability eligibility
gaps.detail: The profile stores a single PwD yes/no answer. The prospectus uses disability type, percentage, assistive-device/function criteria, expert-panel decisions and certificate dates, so the medical matrix requires manual review.

gaps.title: Management/NRI MD/MS/Diploma: Minority eligible religions and mother tongues are not defined
gaps.detail: The minority certificate form records religion and mother tongue and lists enclosures, but does not define which groups qualify or the complete seat priority. Confirm eligible groups and proof with the Selection Committee and institution.
